results.query: What are the basic rules of volleyball scoring?
results.answer: Volleyball uses a rally-point system, where a point is awarded to the team that wins each rally, regardless of which team served. A team must score at least 25 points and lead by two points to win a game. If the score reaches 24-24, play continues until one team leads by two points. A match is typically the first to win two games, though formats may vary. Teams must serve from the right side of the court and rotate positions after each successful serve. The ball must be hit over the net, and a team can touch the ball up to three times before sending it over. Faults like touching the net or stepping on the line result in the opposing team winning the point.
